item.title: github: Faster C++ code intelligence with whole codebase indexing
item.description:
GitHub Copilot CLI now supports whole-codebase indexing for C++ repositories, improving code intelligence performance. The change is aimed at large C++ codebases with many interconnected files.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Copilot CLI no longer needs a personal access token in GitHub Actions
item.description:
GitHub Copilot CLI can now run in GitHub Actions with the built-in GITHUB_TOKEN. A personal access token is no longer required for this workflow.

  • Source: GitHub
